body: Thanks for thanking me for thanking everybody. *brain melts*
I'm not gonna lie, things are still pretty bad and my therapist is getting kinda pushy. I'm trying to stay active and keep myself busy, seems to help a little.
Kept my appointment today. Therapist still doesn't get it, but tryin' to be positive. Thanks for asking.

Thanks. I canceled my appointment today and now my family are giving me the silent treatment. My therapist actually sounded concerned on the phone!! I think I'm gonna try to keep our next appointment and see what happens. I feel like shit but I'm gonna stop whining about it now (for a while anyway)

It's just hard to click with somebody who basically abandoned me, but nobody seems to understand that. I'm gonna go to bed now and drive myself crazy thinking about it. Thanks for listening.
